svg.title: Two Blacks, White and Blue
svg.desc: Interpretive hand-authored study after visual inspection of the1996 Guggenheim retrospective plate. Approximate geometry; interpretive palette. Texture, mounting shadows and perspective omitted. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): specific source-image review of black, blue, white; interpretive screen colors, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://archive.org/download/ellswo00kell/ellswo00kell.pdf#page=127; catalogue 26; visually inspected2026-10-27. Interpretive study, not facsimile.
